text:
mia-partnerships: Quick kickoff — proposing we bundle Snowflake Marketplace, Databricks Partner Connect, and a Qdrant/Pinecone connector announcement in Q2. Goal: one launch runway, staggered releases. :calendar:
alex-eng: I can take Snowflake cert work. Need to confirm External Function approach vs. a native UDF integration. Snowflake wants tests for SQL UDF perf.
sam-ml: For vector DBs we should validate embedding fidelity on small samples — I can run A/B on Pinecone vs Qdrant. Want to avoid any claim about identical results.
jordan-legal: Heads up — joint announcement will need partner signoff on copy and logos. Also check marketplace contract templates for revenue share language.
eva-pm: Timeline proposal: 2 weeks cert & legal, 2 weeks integration QA, 1 week joint marketing assets. So ~5 weeks for Snowflake path. Agree? :thinking_face:
chris-snowflake: From Snowflake side we need: architecture diagram, sample notebook, security checklist (BYOK/KMS), and sample billing mapping. I'll get the partner contact assigned.
mia-partnerships: Nice. Action list I captured: 1) Alex: Snowflake integration + test harness. 2) Sam: vector DB eval & perf doc. 3) Jordan: legal review + partner templates. 4) Eva: launch assets + press draft. 5) Chris: Snowflake partner liaison.
alex-eng: For the test harness I'll add a simple CLI test and a CI job. Example quick test command I was thinking to validate routing:```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1","input":"hello"}' \\n  https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings | jq '.embeddings[0][:5]'
```
sam-ml: Perfect. I'll run that against Pinecone and Qdrant indexes and push results to the eval notebook. I'll also include latency heatmaps for different region combos (us-east1, eu-west1).
jordan-legal: Also note: Snowflake requires data residency notes for marketplace listings. We need to be explicit about model variants hosted in-region vs cross-region. Add to assets.
eva-pm: Marketing needs: 1) one-sentence blurb for marketplace tile, 2) 60s explainer video, 3) partner co-logo SVGs, 4) 2 short case snippets. Who owns the video?
mia-partnerships: I'll coordinate creative with partner marketing. Eva — can you draft the blurb and press outline by EOD Friday?
chris-snowflake: Quick technical note: Snowflake prefers external functions for compute-heavy ops and recommends using their managed VPC for connector traffic. We'll need a small runbook for customers.
alex-eng: Noted. I'll create a runbook snippet and a Terraform module for customers to deploy connector infra. Outline in repo: `infra/snowflake-connector/README.md`.
sam-ml: One risk: token egress when using hosted models -> mention encryption in transit and at rest, and optional customer-managed keys. Will put that into the security doc.
jordan-legal: Also request we don't promise "no egress" — say "controlled egress with BYOK options".
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `partner-integration/test-harness` -> staging at 2026-03-10T14:30Z by alex-eng :white_check_mark:
eva-pm: Marketing ok with that deploy timing. Also, can we plan a small webinar 2 weeks post-launch? target audience: data platform engineers + platform teams.
mia-partnerships: Final check: are there any other vector DB partners we want on the initial list beyond Pinecone and Qdrant? Milvus? Weaviate?
sam-ml: Recommend Weaviate for an OSS option and Pinecone as managed; keep Milvus as backlog. Weaviate adds schema/search hooks we should test.
chris-snowflake: I'll track partner contacts and confirm co-marketing commitments. Expect a contract outline by next Wed.
alex-eng: I'll open the PR for the test harness today and add CI matrix for regions.
jordan-legal: I'll start the partner NDA review and flag any IP clauses for the marketing copy.
eva-pm: I'll draft the launch timeline doc and share a Notion page by tomorrow.
mia-partnerships: Great work — I'll sync with partners and send calendar invites for weekly syncs. Thanks everyone! :pray:
